messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: StanHeaders -- move to its own repository?
parts:
Is everything RStan related going to sit inside the RStan github repo? That is, will RStan live in: github.com/stan-dev/rstan/rstan, StanHeaders in github.com/stan-dev/rstan/StanHeaders?

For me, it's conceptually a lot simpler by separating it. shinystan is living in another directory, so the rstan-related stuff has already been split into multiple repos.

Can you install packages from folders of repositories? If so, I guess there's no real issue and perhaps we should rename github.com/stan-dev/rstan to something else to make it clear that's where we go for everything rstan related and possibly move shinystan under it.

At the very least, we should consolidate the two versions of StanHeaders that exists.



Daniel

There is nothing to consolidate for the two versions of StanHeaders. The one on CRAN is from Josh and is of 2.6.0. The one in the rstan repo is of 2.6.3.
